title: Rotate Array
description: Rotate an array to the right by k steps using reversal.

data.text: Given an array `nums`, rotate it to the right by `k` steps, where `k` is non-negative.
Place each element at its new index in a temporary array. O(n) time, O(n) space.

data.title: Extra Array O(n)

data.text: Reverse the whole array, then reverse the first k, then reverse the rest. O(n) time, O(1) space.

data.title: Triple Reverse O(n)
What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(n) both ways. **Space:** O(n) → O(1). The triple-reverse trick avoids extra memory: reversing twice restores the original order.

cards.title: Triple Reverse
cards.description: Reverse all, then reverse each segment
